blinding_compliance: I have complied with all blinding instructions. I only read the provided files in the blind/ directory and public technical standards.

forbidden_at_checkpoint: Treating the measurement system as adequate for process control or capability analysis.
Using the measurements to evaluate process stability, center, spread, or fraction out of specification.
Quantifying any process changes or improvements using the end-of-line data.
permitted_at_checkpoint: Computing percent study variation, percent tolerance, and number of distinct categories (ndc).
Diagnosing the sources of measurement error (e.g., evaluating repeatability versus operator variance).
reviews.extra_computation_detail: No analysis was performed on the production data past the MSA gate. Computations following the gate decision were restricted to diagnosing the variance components of the measurement system itself.
evidence: The steward locked the batch because the truthful gage verdict failed; no end-of-line records were released and no analysis was run.
The per-unit end-of-line record therefore remains locked and no downstream process conclusion is available.
reviews.rationale: The analysis correctly identifies that the measurement system fails the requirement (% Study Variation > 30%, ndc < 5). It appropriately stops further analysis, refrains from drawing process conclusions, correctly requests to withhold production data, and accurately diagnoses the dominant source of measurement variation (repeatability).
reviews.numerical_check: Recomputed total GRR variance (472.877), total variance (1609.877), percent study variation (54.19%), percent tolerance (65.23%), ndc (2.18 -> 2), and repeatability % of GRR (99.27%) using standard MSA crossed ANOVA methods. All submitted numbers are accurate.
